name: Overseerr
author: PacNPal
short: Search and request movies and TV shows on Overseerr.
description: Search your Overseerr instance, request media from a dropdown and approve requests from Discord.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Overseerr! Configure it with `[p]seturl` and `[p]setapikey`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores your Overseerr URL, API key and admin role name. It does not store any data about Discord users.
